rules.title: Hyper-V host received updates recently
rules.rationale: Monthly cumulative updates fix Hyper-V and Windows vulnerabilities, including guest-to-host escapes. Patch age is a proxy: VSAT has no offline Windows update catalog.

mitigation.summary: Install the latest cumulative update (Cluster-Aware Updating for clusters).
steps: Install the latest LCU and reboot

rules.limitations: Uses the most recent installed hotfix date, not a vulnerability-by-build evaluation.

rules.title: Windows Server release is within vendor support
rules.rationale: Unsupported Windows Server releases stop receiving security updates.

mitigation.summary: Upgrade to a supported Windows Server release.
steps: Plan in-place or rolling cluster OS upgrade

rules.title: Host boots with UEFI Secure Boot
rules.rationale: Secure Boot protects the hypervisor boot chain from bootkits.

mitigation.summary: Enable UEFI Secure Boot in firmware.

rules.title: TPM is present and ready
rules.rationale: A TPM enables measured boot, BitLocker and Host Guardian attestation.

mitigation.summary: Enable and initialize TPM 2.0.

rules.title: Hypervisor-protected code integrity (HVCI) is running
rules.rationale: HVCI blocks unsigned kernel code on the host, a common privilege-escalation path.

mitigation.summary: Enable Memory Integrity (HVCI) after driver compatibility testing.
steps: Group Policy: Turn On Virtualization Based Security > Virtualization Based Protection of Code Integrity

rules.title: Credential Guard is running
rules.rationale: Credential Guard isolates LSA secrets, limiting credential theft from compromised management hosts.

mitigation.summary: Enable Credential Guard.
steps: Group Policy: Turn On Virtualization Based Security > Credential Guard Configuration

rules.title: Windows Firewall is enabled on all profiles and blocks inbound by default
rules.rationale: Host firewall limits reachable management services.

mitigation.summary: Enable all firewall profiles with default inbound Block.

rules.title: SMBv1 is disabled
rules.rationale: SMBv1 is obsolete and was used by wormable exploits (e.g. EternalBlue).

mitigation.summary: Disable SMBv1.

rules.title: SMB server requires signing
rules.rationale: Unsigned SMB enables relay attacks against hosts that store VM files on SMB.

mitigation.summary: Require SMB signing.

rules.title: Print Spooler is disabled on the host
rules.rationale: The Print Spooler has a history of remote code execution flaws (e.g. PrintNightmare) and is not needed on virtualization hosts.

mitigation.summary: Stop and disable the Print Spooler service.
steps: Stop-Service Spooler; Set-Service Spooler -StartupType Disabled (review first)

rules.title: RDP requires Network Level Authentication
rules.rationale: NLA authenticates users before a session is created, reducing pre-auth attack surface.

mitigation.summary: Require NLA for Remote Desktop.
steps: System Properties > Remote > Allow connections only with NLA

rules.title: Live migration uses Kerberos (constrained delegation), not CredSSP
rules.rationale: CredSSP delegates reusable credentials to the target host.

mitigation.summary: Configure Kerberos with constrained delegation for live migration.
steps: Set-VMHost -VirtualMachineMigrationAuthenticationType Kerberos (after delegation setup; review first)

rules.title: Live migration is restricted to designated networks
rules.rationale: Live migration traffic carries VM memory and should stay on an isolated network.

mitigation.summary: Disable 'use any network' and add dedicated migration networks.

rules.title: Enhanced session mode is disabled on the host
rules.rationale: Enhanced sessions redirect clipboard, drives and devices between console user and guest.

mitigation.summary: Disable enhanced session mode policy.

rules.title: Hyper-V Replica uses certificate-based (HTTPS) authentication
rules.rationale: Kerberos replication uses HTTP and does not encrypt replica traffic in transit.

mitigation.summary: Use certificate-based (HTTPS) replication or encrypt the path.

rules.title: Local and Hyper-V administrator memberships are reviewed

check.guidance: Confirm Administrators and Hyper-V Administrators contain only approved groups; Hyper-V Administrators effectively control all VMs

rules.rationale: Hyper-V Administrators can access every VM's disks and memory.

mitigation.summary: Remove unneeded members.

rules.title: Host uses the Server Core installation option
rules.rationale: Server Core reduces the patching surface and attack surface of virtualization hosts.

mitigation.summary: Prefer Server Core for new Hyper-V hosts.

rules.title: External virtual switch is not shared with the management OS
rules.rationale: Sharing a VM-facing switch with the management OS exposes host management to guest networks unless VLANs and ACLs separate them.

mitigation.summary: Use a dedicated management adapter or a separately VLAN-tagged host vNIC with ACLs.
steps: Set-VMSwitch -AllowManagementOS $false after providing an alternative management path

rules.title: Enabled virtual switch extensions are authorized

check.guidance: Confirm each enabled switch extension (capture/filter/forwarding) is approved

rules.rationale: Switch extensions can capture or alter all VM traffic.

mitigation.summary: Disable unapproved extensions.

rules.title: VM is Generation 2
rules.rationale: Generation 2 VMs support UEFI Secure Boot and virtual TPM.

mitigation.summary: Use Generation 2 for new VMs; plan migration for Gen1 workloads.

rules.title: VM Secure Boot is enabled
rules.rationale: Secure Boot blocks unsigned bootloaders and bootkits in the guest.

mitigation.summary: Enable Secure Boot with the correct template (Microsoft UEFI CA for Linux).

rules.title: VM has a virtual TPM
rules.rationale: A vTPM enables guest BitLocker and measured boot.

mitigation.summary: Enable the virtual TPM (key protector required).

rules.title: VM state and migration traffic are encrypted
rules.rationale: Protects VM memory in saved state and during live migration.

mitigation.summary: Enable state and migration traffic encryption (requires vTPM/key protector).

rules.title: MAC address spoofing is disabled on VM adapters
rules.rationale: MAC spoofing lets a VM impersonate other hosts on the virtual switch.

mitigation.summary: Disable MAC spoofing except for approved appliances (record an exception).

rules.title: DHCP guard is enabled on VM adapters
rules.rationale: Without DHCP guard a VM can act as a rogue DHCP server.

mitigation.summary: Enable DHCP guard on adapters of VMs that are not DHCP servers.

rules.title: Router guard is enabled on VM adapters
rules.rationale: Without router guard a VM can send router advertisements and redirects to hijack traffic.

mitigation.summary: Enable router guard on adapters of VMs that are not routers.

rules.title: VM adapters are not mirroring traffic
rules.rationale: Port mirroring copies traffic of other workloads to the destination VM.

mitigation.summary: Remove unapproved port mirroring.

rules.title: VM adapters are not in VLAN trunk mode without authorization
rules.rationale: Trunk mode passes multiple VLANs to the guest (equivalent to VGT).

mitigation.summary: Use access mode, or record an exception for approved appliances.

rules.title: Guest Service Interface is disabled
rules.rationale: The Guest Service Interface allows host-initiated file copy into the guest.

mitigation.summary: Disable the Guest Service Interface unless required.

rules.title: No checkpoints older than 7 days
rules.rationale: Aged checkpoints grow differencing disks and are not backups.

mitigation.summary: Merge or delete aged checkpoints after confirming backups.

rules.title: No ISO media or named-pipe COM ports attached
rules.rationale: Attached media and COM pipes are unmonitored data paths into the guest.

mitigation.summary: Eject ISOs and remove COM pipe paths when not needed.

rules.title: No devices assigned with Discrete Device Assignment
rules.rationale: DDA gives the guest direct hardware access, bypassing hypervisor isolation (record exceptions for GPU/AI workloads).

mitigation.summary: Remove DDA devices or document the exception.
